steps.description: Oleic acid, Octadecene, and CdO are poured into the flask.
The mixture is stirred at room temperature.
The mixture is heated to 120 C under vacuum.
The mixture is cooled to room temperature.
OA and ODE are injected into the flask.
Se and S powders are added into the flask.
The reactor is heated to 240 C for 7 h.
The reactor is cooled to room temperature.
The product is precipitated with a mixture of cyclohexane and ethanol.
The product is centrifuged to remove the supernatant.
The pellet is re-suspended in cyclohexane.
The puriﬁcation recipe is repeated ﬁve times.
